title: Missionary to Europe after fiery Columbanus.
html_source: Columbanus was an Irish missionary who indeed went to Europe and was a founding member of several monasteries. This seems to connect with Stephen’s frustrated goal of “changing the world”, and his European travels he recounts later in the chapter.
